meaning:
ἀγενής, -ές
(γένος),
1. unborn (Plat.);
2. of no family, ignoble, base (opposite to ἀγαθός, Soph., Fr., 105): opposite to εὐγενής, 1Co.1:28 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
